verdict.rationale: Anytype supports offline-first local storage, Queries (filter by criteria/properties), Types/custom Types, and links/graph for relationship tracing, plus a local API for querying objects and properties — all functioning offline since data is stored on-device. However, there's no explicit documentation of full-text search across all notes, nor filtering specifically on 'tags' and 'paths' as unified search criteria; Queries are described as criteria-based views rather than full-text search, and community feedback notes usability issues with graph view at scale. missing for 10: dedicated full-text search documentation, explicit tag/path filter combination, independent verification of search performance/offline search reliability at scale.
